all decisive key geometry, spacing, support-confidence states and timing

principle: ROOT HEIGHT MAY DROP ONLY AFTER LOWER SUPPORT EARNS AUTHORITY, AND FORWARD MOMENTUM MUST SURVIVE THAT HEIGHT TRANSACTION.
quality_thesis: The lead foot reaches the lower level while the root is still owned by the upper tread; mixed-height dual support visibly delays root drop. Lower support then owns a compressed descent while forward travel survives, producing late upper release, an overlong first lower-level catch, shorter corrections, secondary lag, and displaced settle.

keys.name: UPPER_APPROACH
keys.causal_role: establish upper-tread ownership and forward intent before the height discontinuity

keys.name: EDGE_READ
keys.causal_role: upper support keeps the root high while the free foot searches downward

keys.name: LOWER_PROBE
keys.causal_role: lower contact appears at the new height but does not yet own the root

keys.name: MIXED_HEIGHT_ACQUIRE
keys.causal_role: both supports are trustworthy at different heights; root remains high to prove acquisition precedes descent

keys.name: LOWER_DOMINANCE
keys.causal_role: lower support takes root ownership and the COM begins the quantized descent while upper support still lags

keys.name: ROOT_DROP_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: root and COM fall around the fixed lower support only after authority is earned; torso and arms overrun the vertical impulse

keys.name: UPPER_RELEASE_LATE
keys.causal_role: the trailing upper foot releases late; forward travel survives instead of resetting at the step

keys.name: LOWER_SUPPORT_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: root passes beyond the fixed right support while the left foot reaches forward for the first free lower-level catch

keys.name: LONG_LEFT_BOTTOM_CATCH
keys.causal_role: surviving horizontal debt produces the longest lower-level catch; left support must own before correction

keys.name: BOTTOM_ABSORB
keys.causal_role: left support stays world-fixed while root/COM compress and upper-body lag overshoots

keys.name: SHORT_RIGHT_CORRECTION
keys.causal_role: a shorter opposite-foot catch pays remaining travel debt without returning to gait symmetry

keys.name: REBOUND_SECONDARY_LAG
keys.causal_role: root restacks while arms lag behind the rebound and support prepares to hand off

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: settle remains displaced down-course on the lower level; no idle reset or reverse interpolation

quality_history.defect: The first lower support sat at the vertical riser, so the lower-tread ownership read ambiguously as an edge pin.
quality_history.correction: Move K02 lower probe and K03-K07 right-foot support beyond the edge to x=132 and keep it world-fixed.

quality_history.basis: Fresh current-worker inspection: mixed-height acquisition visibly precedes descent; right lower support remains world-fixed through body passage; forward spacing survives the vertical transaction; K08 is the longest lower-level catch; K09-K12 pay compression, shorter correction, rebound lag and displaced settle.

Same final render: stair-height transaction is causal, asymmetric silhouettes progress through probe/acquire/drop/overrun/catch, and recovery retains visible debt rather than returning to a gait loop.
